name: Shane Dawson

His sketch comedy and character-driven content rapidly gained traction, making him one of the earliest YouTube superstars.

evidence_summary: Shane Dawson grew up in poverty in Long Beach with an alcoholic absent father and a single mother, was bullied for his weight, and turned to comedy and video-making as a coping mechanism from age 10.
